# Dev Jain Portfolio - Full Context for Language Models

## Summary
This site is the personal portfolio and blog of Dev Jain, a software engineer specialising in React Native and Next.js. It covers production mobile engineering, release automation, performance work, and shipping AI agents.

## Audience
- Hiring managers
- Engineering leaders
- Product teams seeking collaboration
- Developers interested in mobile architecture and performance

## Professional Profile
- Name: Dev Jain
- Role: Software Engineer (React Native, Next.js)
- Location: Hyderabad, India
- Focus areas: mobile release engineering, performance, bundle size, maintainability, AI agents
- Value proposition: ships mobile and web products end-to-end, from idea to production

## Experience Highlights
- Software Engineer, Vela (formerly Reewild), Aug 2025 - Present, Hyderabad (on-site).
  Owns the development-to-deployment pipeline with CI/CD and OTA updates using Maestro, EAS Workflows, and GitHub Actions. Migrated the app from the Ignite boilerplate to Expo Router. Made the codebase agent-ready with AGENTS.md and SKILLS.md. Shipped production AI agents with Hermes on Azure Container Apps. Cut download size by 60% on iOS and 44% on Android. Implemented client-side feature flagging with Statsig.
- Software Engineer Intern, Vela (formerly Reewild), Jan 2025 - Jul 2025, London (remote).
  Built the React Native frontend for the 'Planet Points' launch, shipped 'Receipt Scanning' with camera-based OCR in a two-week sprint, and cut bundle size by 100 MB.
- Web Developer, PSS TECHNO SERVICE, Oct 2024 - Dec 2024.
  Built and maintained dynamic client websites with React and PHP.
